purpose: Record the immediately certified-looking tightening candidate obtained from the HPADJ21 exact-qA refinement using only already measured strict cells/rows, while leaving all unmeasured FULL178 cells at their HPADJ20 values.

structural_monotonicity.coarse_rule: HPADJ20 keeps exact minimum qA and assigns every remaining tuple the exact second-smallest qA as a common lower bound.
structural_monotonicity.refined_rule: HPADJ21 keeps every exact qA bin with exact multiplicity.
structural_monotonicity.survivor_monotonicity: For fixed parity cap multiset, survivor_count(q)=#caps>=q is nonincreasing in q. Therefore every HPADJ21 exact-qA tuple has survivor ratio no larger than the corresponding HPADJ20 two-tier tuple.
structural_monotonicity.lp_monotonicity: The exact-predomain LP maximizes a fixed post mass by greedily filling capacities in decreasing survivor/B ratio. Moving capacity only to equal-or-lower ratios cannot increase that optimum.
structural_monotonicity.consequence: Every unmeasured FULL178 cell may conservatively retain its HPADJ20 objective while measured strict cells/rows replace only their same-cell HPADJ20 objective.

promotion_requirements: independent replay/source-lock verification of the two retained EX5 measurements
hostile audit of the structural survivor/LP monotonicity argument against the exact HPADJ20/HPADJ21 source semantics
MAIN replacement transition using min(current_authority,candidate_upper_bound), not additive subtraction
claim-sync/audit gate before any authority credit
